name: leather
_design_note: F1-15 light. With leather material = +1 AC; with studded_leather = +2.
lore_template: This cuirass of {material_name} was hardened and shaped upon a wooden form, and it is light enough to run in, yet tough enough to turn the tip of a dagger.

forms_words.blunt: takes the sting from a blow

forms_note: Thick leather slows an edge and takes the sting from a blow; a point goes straight in.
